dependencies.name: Windows WinHTTP
dependencies.selection: existing Windows SDK and system runtime
dependencies.role: HTTPS GET with system certificate verification
dependencies.redistribution_rule: Do not copy winhttp.dll or Windows SDK files into project artifacts.

dependencies.name: libcurl
dependencies.selection: explicit system shared SDK prefix; headers/runtime >= 7.81.0, TLS and asynchronous DNS required
dependencies.role: HTTPS GET with SDK default trust store and peer/hostname verification
dependencies.transitive_dependencies: SDK TLS/resolver/compression libraries remain separately licensed system packages
dependencies.redistribution_rule: Project does not vendor/install curl, its CA bundle, or transitive libraries; any future bundling must retain exact licenses/notices and complete security/dependency review.
dependencies.provenance: CMake records selected curlver.h and resolved shared-library SHA-256; no generic SDK version is claimed as release-qualified.
